paper_metadata.title: Achieving Strength and Toughness in Dual-Phase Mg-8Li Alloys Through Phase Structure Control and Composite Fracture

evidence.quote: The rising industrial demand for ultra-lightweight materials with exceptional strength and toughness has intensified interest in dual-phase Mg-Li alloys due to their low density and high specific strength.
The defining microstructural feature of dual-phase Mg-Li alloys, in contrast to conventional magnesium alloys, is the coexistence of the HCP-structured α-phase and the BCC-structured β-phase.
